name: LitterCaching
shortDescription: MakeUofT 2025 build: ESP32-CAM glasses running an Edge Impulse can-recognition model, plus a 3D-printed claw grabber on a PVC pole.
description:
LitterCaching is a three-part litter-collection project built at MakeUofT 2025 (February 2025).

What's in the repo:
- Smart glasses with an ESP32-CAM in a 3D-printed housing, running an Edge Impulse model trained to recognize cans (firmware and training data in `glasses_software/`).
- A handheld grabber: a PVC pole with a 3D-printed claw system, tension handle, rubber-band clamps and press-fit nut holders, controlled from an Arduino in its own housing.
- A third part with an IR sensor housing.
